12.t: Working with data: glucose after a meal
q: What was person B’s highest glucose level?
How long did person A take to return to the starting level?
Explain how person A’s level was brought back down.
The pancreas released insulin: cells took in glucose and the liver stored it as glycogen.
Suggest which person may have diabetes, with two pieces of evidence.
Person B: higher glucose before the drink (7), a much higher peak (14), and it stays high after 3 hours (insulin not made or not working).
